_note: West Virginia 2026 election cycle: key dates and official links for the November 3, 2026 general election. Each date was read on the official page in key_date_sources on the day in key_date_retrieved. reminder_notes.vote_by_mail_request_deadline_general: Your application must be received, not just postmarked, by then. Mail voting in West Virginia is only for voters who meet the state's eligibility rules. Check them on the official site.
